question: The Purkinje cells of the cerebellum receive direct input from:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Neurons of deep cerebellar nuclei -> Purkinje cells of the cerebellum receive direct input -> 80% CHAIN: Climbing fibers -> Synapse directly onto Purkinje cells -> 75% CHAIN: Mossy fibers -> Synapse onto granule cells -> Granule cells synapse onto Purkinje cells -> 70% CHAIN: Pyramidal neurons of cerebral cortex -> Project to pontine nuclei -> Pontine nuclei project to cerebellum -> 60% CHAIN: Spinal neurons -> Project to cerebellum via spinocerebellar tracts -> Indirectly influence Purkinje cells -> 80%
